radiusSource: Radius 4.906 (4.800 to 5.006) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 3,413,324 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.770 (1.714 to 1.810) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5085 +/- 20.7 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 4246124829130366848: teff_gspphot 5085.218 K (16th-84th percentiles 5053.567-5094.9756), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 4246124829130366848: teff_gspphot 5085.218 K (16th-84th percentiles 5053.567-5094.9756), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
